shortDescription: India's central bank approved ICICI Prudential AMC NSE:ICICIAMC acquiring an aggregate holding of up to 9.95% in four lenders, including Kotak Mahindra Bank NSE:KOTAKBANK, parent ICICI Bank said on Wednesday.Here are more details:

children: India's central bank approved ICICI Prudential AMC
acquiring an aggregate holding of up to 9.95% in four lenders, including Kotak Mahindra Bank
, parent ICICI Bank said on Wednesday.
ICICI Prudential AMC can acquire stakes of up to 9.95% in CSB Bank
The Reserve Bank of India's approvals require the asset manager to complete the share purchases within one year, failing which the approvals will lapse.
These standard portfolio investments are passive holdings acquired as part of routine portfolio management rather than for exercising control or influencing the management of a bank.
